title: Velvetta or don't bother
text: Velvetta or don't bother. This product is designed strictly for Velveeta or similar type of cheese.  The serrated edge blade just hacks away at other cheeses.  It's difficult to keep moving the blade back as you slice the cheese.  It's just easier to cut the cheese by hand.

product_metadata.title: Progressive International Slicing Cheese Keeper
features: Stores up to a 2 lb block of cheese
Slice cheese from the keeper using its leveraged slicing blade
Lid controls air flow and reduces moisture-keeps cheese longer
Base is used as a cutting board
Remove cutting blade for easy cleaning; Safe to use in the dishwasher
description: Progressive International is your source for the widest range of functional, inventive, and fun kitchen tools and great ideas put into practice. Our in-house designers spend hours in the kitchen coming up with ways to improve on a variety of traditional tasks and tools. Established in 1973, our commitment to quality and service allows us to offer a broad selection of quality kitchenware and other household products. This slicing cheese keeper fits up to a 2lb block of cheese. An integrated slicing blade with leverage handles make slicing cheese easier. The blade is removable for easy cleaning. Its clear lid helps control air flow and moisture keeping cheese fresh and reduces odor absorption. The base of the keeper acts as a cutting board and can also be used as a serving tray. Dishwasher safe.
